test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 09 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In which year did the National Development Council (NDC) recommend a national policy on co-operatives?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**1958**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **National Development Council (NDC)** was established in 1952 as an advisory body to strengthen and mobilize the effort and resources for the country's development.
 
• In **1958**, the NDC recognized the importance of **co-operative societies** in fostering economic and social development in India.
 
• It recommended the formulation of a **national policy on co-operatives** to ensure their effective role in achieving socio-economic objectives like rural development and poverty alleviation.
 
• The **co-operative movement** in India has a long history, and its aim is to promote self-help and mutual aid among its members.
 
• Co-operatives played a critical role in **agriculture, credit institutions, rural industries, and marketing**, which were crucial for post-independence development.
 
• The recommendation in 1958 was instrumental in expanding the co-operative sector with the support of the government, leading to the establishment of laws like the **Multi-State Co-operative Societies Act, 2002**.
 
• This policy emphasized the need for **autonomy, democratic management, and economic viability** of co-operatives.
 
• It also advocated for the creation of an enabling environment for co-operatives to thrive as self-reliant and sustainable entities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **1947**__

 __
 
• This was the year of **India's independence**, and the focus of the government was on nation-building and planning for economic development.
 
• While co-operatives existed before independence, no specific recommendation for a national policy was made in this year.
 
 
 
• **1962**__
 __
 
• This year marked the initiation of the **Third Five-Year Plan**, focusing on agricultural development, but it was not the year when the NDC recommended a national co-operative policy.
 
• By this time, co-operatives were already being implemented in areas like credit and rural development.
 
 
 
• **1975**__
 
 
• This year is significant for the introduction of the **Twenty-Point Programme** by the Government of India, which also included co-operatives under rural development schemes.
 
• However, this was not the year of the NDC's recommendation for a national policy on co-operatives.
